item.tib: spyi 'dus dran pa'i thugs tig las rtsa gsum dbang mchog byang chub lam gyi shing rta
item.coloph: ces 'jam dpal dran pa rtsa gsum gyi dbang chog gsang chen lam gyi shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni gnas mchog kong po bon ri la 'gro don phebs lam duH mkha' 'gro'i lung gi (gis)bsngags bzhin rig 'dzin gyi tshogs bskang (skong) rgya cher phul zhing gter bdag nye bar bskul rjes yul zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum gyi phyi sgo shod chen bco brgyad las gyim shod rdzong chen drug las shel le rdzong zhes rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i gnas nas shog ser gter bdag gis gnangs su (gnang du) khyer te dri bzang gi ngad dang bcas nas phul byung cing slar yang bka' rgya grol tshe sems dpa' bstan sbyin lung zin bka' bab tshogs kyis bskul ngor lcags rta zla tshes bzang por stag bro g.yung drung dga' tshal du o rgyan pad ma gling pas mkha' 'gro'i brda las 'ol tsam byung ba la rig pas bkrol nas bris pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun du bzhugs cing 'gro rnams thar par 'khod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig
